A fancy '''resort club''' was in operation above the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. At some point, there were some retired [[air rodeo]] [[Thranta/Legends|thrantas]] located at the club. One [[Standard day/Legends|day]] when the club was open, a [[Unidentified criminal (Bespin resort club)|criminal]] came to the club, troubled the residents greatly, and left in the last available [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]].<ref name="Rodeo" />
{{RPGseed}}
In response to the criminal's actions, a group of individuals speedily pursued the criminal riding the club's thrantas.<ref name="Rodeo" />
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The resort club first appeared as part of an adventure idea in "[[Rodeo Thranta]]," an article written by [[Jeff Quick]] for the ''[[Creature Feature]]'' series of articles that was published on [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Wizards.com|website]] to expand the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. The article was released on [[December]] [[December 12|12]], [[2002]], with the adventure ideas and locations being usable by Game Masters at any time after thrantas were first used in air rodeos, which happened before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the thrantas' [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Rodeo" />
